description: This file defines the interface and implementation of a GstWrapper class and a factory class for wrapping GStreamer functionalities, including methods for initializing GStreamer, managing plugins, elements, pads, buffers, and messages, as well as utility functions for caps and structures. It is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and provides external references to GStreamer core functions.
